spanish: Y cuando fuere en la calvicie o en la frente calva plaga blanca rojiza, tsaráat brotante ella en su calvicie o en su frente calva.

findings.issue: Common noun צָרַעַת (H6883) is dumped as the untranslated transliteration tsaráat; it is not a proper name.

notes: Remaining tokens match: וכי, יהיה 3ms, article on both absolute baldness nouns, או, נגע לבן אדמדם, feminine participle, 3fs pronoun, and both 3ms suffixed nouns.
